title: Apparel and Footwear Return Window
text: Apparel and footwear items can be returned within 7 days of delivery when the item meets the applicable return conditions. The item should remain eligible for return under the category policy.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics can be returned within 10 days of delivery when the product satisfies the applicable return conditions. Product-specific exclusions may still apply.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home-category products can be returned within 7 days of delivery when the item satisfies the applicable return conditions and eligibility requirements.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For eligible COD orders, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the required return processing checks. The refund timeline begins after the refund is approved.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For eligible prepaid orders, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the required return processing checks. The amount is then sent through the applicable original payment route.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery is expected within the delivery estimate shown for the order. Delivery timing can vary by destination, seller processing, and operational conditions.

title: Delayed Delivery Handling
text: When an order passes its expected delivery estimate, the customer can check the latest tracking status before requesting further delivery support.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available when the order and item are eligible for return and the pickup service is available for the delivery location.

title: Return Condition Requirement
text: Returned items must satisfy the applicable category return conditions before the return can be approved. Items that do not meet those conditions may be rejected.

title: Return Request Process
text: A customer should raise the return request through the order support flow while the item is within its applicable return window. The request is then checked against the relevant policy conditions.

title: Delivery Tracking
text: Customers can use the order tracking information to view the latest delivery status. Tracking updates may appear as the shipment moves through different delivery stages.

title: Pickup Attempt
text: When a reverse pickup is scheduled, the pickup partner attempts collection according to the available pickup schedule. If a pickup attempt fails, the customer may need to follow the support flow for another attempt.
